label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) is alert-TP. Data flows from request.getHeader('Referer') -> param -> valuesList.add(param) -> valuesList.remove(0) -> valuesList.get(0) -> bar -> response.getWriter().println(bar). No HTML encoding is performed on bar before writing to the response body. The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input. Disabling X-XSS-Protection header indicates intentional disabling of defenses.
